items.title: A Claude Code skill that recovers export-blocked Kindle highlights
items.why_it_matters: A developer shipped a custom Claude Code skill that bypasses Kindle's export restrictions to recover highlights. It is a highly practical, real-world example of how to extend Claude Code's capabilities with custom tools. Since you use Claude Code daily, you can study this repository's structure this week and write a simple custom skill to let Claude Code query your Supabase database schema directly from your terminal.

items.title: Show HN: Poka-Yoke – mistake-proofing skills for Claude Code, with a benchmark
items.why_it_matters: Poka-Yoke is an open-source benchmark and set of mistake-proofing skills designed specifically for Claude Code to prevent common agent errors. As someone who relies on AI to write the actual code, learning how to constrain the agent is key to becoming a better director. You can clone this repository today and run its checks against your AI-ingest project to see if Claude Code has introduced any silent bugs in your Next.js files.

items.title: GitMir – an open source IDE that fixes your Claude development
items.why_it_matters: GitMir is a new open-source IDE designed specifically to optimize your development workflow when coding with Claude. If you find yourself fighting with terminal context or switching windows constantly, this provides a dedicated interface for agent-led development. You can download GitMir this week and open your AI-ingest repository in it to see if it makes directing Claude smoother than your current setup.

items.title: Session-migrate: Migrate coding agent sessions across Claude Code, Codex, Pi
items.why_it_matters: Session-migrate is a lightweight utility that lets you migrate active coding agent sessions across Claude Code, Codex, and Pi. This is useful if you start a task in one environment but want to switch to another without losing the agent's context and history. You can install this tool today and use it to move your current AI-ingest development session from Claude Code over to Codex to compare how they handle the same task.

items.title: OCR It – pull text out of un-copyable documents for your LLM
items.why_it_matters: OCR It is an open-source tool designed to extract clean text from un-copyable documents and images specifically for feeding into LLMs. Since your AI-ingest project is all about filtering information, this tool helps bypass paywalls or image-only formats. You can clone this repository this week and use its CLI to convert a screenshot of a Twitter thread into clean markdown text for Claude to summarize.
